status.title: நிலை
status.name: பெயர்
status.not_configured: Set a host name in Settings to publish Odoo.
status.first_run_desc: Odoo starts empty. Open the database manager, enter the master password, and create your first database (pick a name, set the admin email/password, choose demo data or not).
status.master_password_note: The master password is stored in the module settings on the server (node-admin readable).

settings.title: அமைப்புகள்
settings.host_helper: Public host name where Odoo is reachable. It must resolve to this server.
settings.timezone_not_valid: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
settings.workers_helper: 0 = threaded mode, one route, live chat works
settings.database_help: The database manager creates, backs up and restores Odoo databases. It is protected by the master password.
settings.master_password_helper_set: A master password is set. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.ldap_help: Let users sign in to Odoo with their Active Directory or LDAP credentials. Settings are stored here; apply them to each database below.
settings.ldap_password_helper_set: A bind password is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.ldap_password_helper_unset: Password of the bind account. Leave empty for anonymous bind.
settings.ldap_create_user: Create Odoo users on first login
settings.ldap_ad_hint_desc: For Active Directory use port 389 with StartTLS on.
settings.ldap_apply_help: Odoo stores LDAP settings per database. Pick a database and apply the settings saved above.
settings.ldap_apply_no_db: Create a database first (Odoo stores LDAP per database).
settings.ldap_apply_failed: Some databases could not be updated. {detail}
settings.ldap_not_enabled: Enable and save directory login before applying it.

about.title: பற்றி
about.details: Odoo 19 community edition with PostgreSQL, self-built from the official Odoo image. Drop your own or OCA add-ons into the add-ons folder mounted at /mnt/extra-addons.
